messages:
maya: Quick UX sweep on the Privacy Controls flow — noticed a handful of small nits: retention selector feels buried, region order is confusing (NA/APAC/EU expected), and the "Encryption / KMS" label is unclear. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/priv-controls-2026.png
liam: I saw that too. My first thought: move retention up higher in the modal so it's visible before the save CTA. Also the dropdown default could say 'Same as account' rather than a blank.
anika: Moving retention up is OK from the frontend side, but backend expects retention to be in the body of the POST as `retention_days` — that'll be unchanged. We just need the UI to prefill based on account settings when opening the modal.
ethan: For KMS wording, legal prefers "Customer-managed keys (KMS)" to reduce ambiguity. Current copy "Encryption: Customer-managed keys" sounds fine but longer. We should avoid using internal acronyms without expansion on first mention.
olivia: Accessibility nits: color contrast on the blue "KMS linked" badge is failing AA on hover. Also keyboard focus for the region list jumps to a non-obvious element — needs a clear focus ring. ARIA: region dropdown needs `aria-label="Data residency region"`.
sam-bot: Quick audit results: accessibility-checker v2.1 ran on /console/privacy-controls — 3 warnings (color contrast x2, focus order x1). Details: https://ci.redwood/axs/1813456789
liam: Copy suggestion for the audit log tooltip — current tooltip: "Audit logs show changes." Too vague. Suggest: `Audit log shows who changed privacy settings, what was changed, and when (for compliance).` Shorten in UI to: `View change history` and put the detailed line in the hover tooltip.
manika: small correction — my name is anika :)
anika: noted :) also, for the region dropdown ordering: let's show the user's preferred region first, then alphabetical order for the rest. That solves most confusion for customers with single-region expectation.
ethan: Also, for KMS badge we should provide a hover help: `Customer-managed key via KMS — required for bringing your own keys. Learn more` and link to docs. That avoids ambiguous short labels.
maya: Good. Priorities: 1) retention placement + default prefill 2) KMS badge copy + hover 3) region order + aria label 4) contrast + focus ring. Who wants owner?
liam: I'll take 2 & 4 (copy + contrast/focus).
anika: I'll take 1 & 3 (retention placement + region order/prefill). I might need a tiny API tweak to surface account default on GET /settings — is that available?
manika: (anika) we have account defaults via /settings/v1 returning `privacy_defaults` — should be fine.
ethan: I'll review the KMS hover text and doc link. Also confirm there's no security implication of showing KMS status in the modal (it's read-only).
olivia: I'll add the ARIA attributes and run keyboard tests in VoiceOver/ChromeVox. Sam-bot, can you re-run checks after Liam's changes?
sam-bot: Scheduled re-run: accessibility-checker v2.1 on branch `privacy-controls-ux` in 10m. CI link: https://ci.redwood/axs/run/1813456799
liam: Proposed micro-copy (candidates):
```
Badge: "Customer-managed key (KMS)"
Hover: "Customer-managed key via KMS. Keys stored in your KMS. Learn more: https://docs.redwood/inference/kms"
Audit CTA: "View change history"
Audit tooltip: "Shows who changed privacy settings, what changed, and when. Data retained per your retention policy."
```
liam: Thoughts?
ethan: LGTM. Maybe swap 'Keys stored in your KMS' -> 'Keys stored in your KMS or vault' to cover HSM customers.
liam: Good call.
maya: Let's capture as tasks in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PRIV-342 — I'll add the owners/acceptance criteria.
olivia: Accessibility acceptance: contrast >= 4.5:1 for normal text, clear focus ring visible at 3px, tab order linear across controls.
anika: ETA: I'll get a PR up today for the layout changes and prefill.
liam: I'll drop the copy PR + CSS patch for focus.
ethan: I'll add the KMS doc link to the docs PR.
maya: Great — thanks team. If anyone spots other wording that's ambiguous (e.g., "retention period" vs "data retention"), flag in the ticket. :thumbsup:
